'''Dorston''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served in the [[Marblewood security force|security force]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]]. He was one of the many security guards working for the [[Black Sun sector chief|sector chief]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], [[Avrak Villachor]]. He was one of the several guards whom [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] group attempted to bribe in order to have Villachor lose faith in his own guards. Dorston remained faithful to his employer and reported the attempted bribery to his superiors.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
